tagline_en: Stop hunting and testing skills one by one. Get training, tuning, eval, and deployment in one install—save the.

why_en: It gathers scattered ML workflows into one reusable set—clear structure after install, no manual assembly, version guessing, or.
limit_zh: 只覆盖通用机器学习流程，不含深度学习框架专属调优；每个技能需自行确认数据格式与运行环境；装完不附带示例数据。
limit_en: Covers general ML workflows only, no deep-learning-framework-specific tuning. You must verify data formats and runtime env per skill. No sample data.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
